title: The rail-jump page test (a rail jump after Send lands on its card) is a race: it reads the card top after the first scrollend, which can fire before the smooth scroll starts
why: Consultant message to triage 9, 18:26 CST Nov 16 (relayed; agent read, cause unproven). Test skills/waiting-page/tests/page.test.mjs lines 6253-6270 reads the card top after the first scrollend.
